rektion: aus + Dat. (aus dem Zug, aus der S-Bahn, aus dem Auto aussteigen)
meaning_en: to get off, to get out (of a vehicle)
definition_de: ein Fahrzeug verlassen (aus dem Bus, aus dem Zug, aus dem Auto aussteigen). Übertragen: bei etwas nicht mehr mitmachen (aus einem Projekt aussteigen).
example_de: Als die Türen aufgingen, stieg sie mit ihrem schweren Koffer aus der S-Bahn aus.
example_en: When the doors opened, she got off the S-Bahn with her heavy suitcase.
visual_idea: Collocation 'aus der S-Bahn aussteigen', the most common everyday use. A still of someone at train doors can read as einsteigen, so the direction is the meaning: the card shows the woman already on the platform walking away from the open doors toward the viewer, and a first+last-frame video shows her stepping out of the train. Every noun of the sentence is visible (open doors, heavy suitcase, S-Bahn). Start and card frames share one camera sentence, so the video only animates the step out.
image_prompt: view from the platform straight at the wide open sliding doors of a red commuter train, each door red on top with a white lower half, the doors in the exact centre of the frame, platform edge in the foreground, bright daylight, plain clean station with no signs or displays, static medium shot, a young woman with long brown hair, a dark grey padded jacket and jeans walks toward the camera two metres in front of the doors, her face clearly visible, pulling a large dark blue suitcase, the empty train behind her
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_start_prompt: view from the platform straight at the wide open sliding doors of a red commuter train, each door red on top with a white lower half, the doors in the exact centre of the frame, platform edge in the foreground, bright daylight, plain clean station with no signs or displays, static medium shot, a young woman with long brown hair, a dark grey padded jacket and jeans stands on the raised floor inside the train, framed by the doorway, her face toward the camera, a large dark blue suitcase beside her, the platform empty
